'''Ilm Vaz-Weplinn''' was an [[Assistant-Deputy Viceprex]], and eventually [[Vice-President in charge of Corporate Security|Viceprex]], of [[Security Division]] with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

==Biography==
Ilm contacted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Minister of Corrections]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]] and proposed the joint development of an advanced prison facility in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Chawcroft was pleased with this proposal: her ministry welcomed the chance to share costs of prison development with the CSA, and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] had blocked the budget requests of the [[Admiralty (Imperial)/Legends|Admiralty]] for their own prison facilities.<ref name="HSCSSB" />

Shortly after she signed on, Viceprex [[Mirkovig Hirken]] took control of the project, code-named "Stars' End".<ref name="HSCSSB" />

Following the [[Liberation of Stars' End|Mytus VII disaster]] and the death of Hirken, Vaz-Weplinn was named [[Vice-President in charge of Corporate Security|Viceprex of Security]] by the [[Executive Directorship Board]].<ref name="HSCSSB" />
